claims.explanation: Pyrimethamine selectively kills cancer cells that depend on DHFR-mediated one-carbon metabolism and folate transport, likely due to high DHFR expression or increased uptake via SLC47A1. Resistance may arise from mutations in TP53 or other pathways that alter drug response, but the strongest predictor is DHFR expression levels.

features.basis: Pyrimethamine is a DHFR inhibitor; high expression may indicate dependency.
SLC47A1 is an annotated target and may mediate drug uptake.
TP53 mutations are common in least affected lines and may reduce drug sensitivity.
KRAS mutations appear in several least affected lines, suggesting resistance.
BRAF mutations are present in multiple least affected lines.
PIK3CA mutations are frequent in least affected lines.
PTEN mutations appear in several least affected lines.
ARID1A mutations are common in least affected lines.
KMT2D mutations are frequent in least affected lines.
NFE2L2 mutations appear in several least affected lines.
CDKN2A mutations are present in multiple least affected lines.
SMARCA4 mutations appear in several most killed lines.
